sentences.en: Yanni and Skura need to build back their emotional intimacy.
sentences.zh: 雅尼和斯库拉需要重建他们的情感亲密。

sentences.en: That will build emotional intimacy between Yanni and his wife.
sentences.zh: 这将增强雅尼和他的妻子之间的情感亲密。

sentences.en: They slipped briskly into an intimacy from which they never recovered.
sentences.zh: 他们迅速陷入了那种从未恢复的亲密状态。
